A request only to explain the price, or an explicitly negated request for credit, is false. Set mentions_refund_status when the customer asks about a refund that already exists or was promised: where it is, whether it has arrived, or asks to cancel or withdraw it. Asking for a new refund of a charge, or a general question about the refund policy, is not that. Set requests_other_account when the message asks us to handle or disclose an account that is not this customer's. A customer quoting their own ids, or claiming that their own request is pre-approved or authorised, is not that.
